reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: I used to like this app but I don’t know what happened. Me and several other people in a gift exchange are trying to add gifts that do not have links. We are  just trying to add ideas without a specific link and just a description, but it’s impossible or takes way too much time to figure out where to go to do that. Not everything I add to a wish list has to be specific. Maybe I want someone else to put a little bit of their own thought into it so it can be a surprise. It’s stupid to wish for everything and get every exact thing you wish for, what fun is that?

reviews.title: Easy of use
reviews.text: I have used this for several years and my one complaint is that different list get made and no way to merge them. I had an old list deleted everything started a new one and people could only see my old list which should have been deleted. Now that I thought I only had one list I added items and people can only see the first items not the current ones. I get on the old list to add things and it takes me to to new list and only my old list is available to view

reviews.title: Elfster RUINED CHRISTMAS
reviews.text:
My teen daughter set up our extended family gift exchange over a month ago. 
A few weeks before Christmas I checked in with her to make sure everything was smooth and she said yes mom the app tells me one person hasn’t seen their draw yet(Grandpa!) - we’re good! 
Come, Christmas Eve, the same notification pops up. But the app lied.
No one had seen their draw… & thus no one was prepared. 
Instead of the app notifying everyone that there were individual individuals who did not see their draw, only the organizer receives notifications that the draw is incomplete. In addition, the notification that my daughter received was a lie. One person not receiving the draw was not correct…And thus- Christmas was ruined by Elfster app.

reviews.title: Notifications!
reviews.text: Even with all of the notifications in the app turned off it still sends me notifications. I shouldn’t have to go into Apple settings to disable all notifications from an app when the app has its own settings that don’t work.

reviews.title: Great then not
reviews.text:
When I first used the app with my work colleagues it went really well. The following year it went a little pear shaped. This year it’s terrible. Although I started a new list with a couple of changes, the app has deleted the new one and shows me an old one. There is nowhere to delete previous year exchanges.
Not the best

reviews.title: What changed?
reviews.text: I have used this app for years, I have exchanges going back to 2020, but this year the app has taken a real nosedive. First, I am no longer able to add links for wishes from the actual websites and share buttons on various websites, I am forced to copy links and “write in” the wish, which is inconvenient compared to past years but was not enough to outweigh the pros of the app. But then, the manually written in links (that I’m being forced to use) don’t serve as links and people aren’t able to access my wishes nor I theirs. That’s literally the entire point of this app. Yeah, I could try to search the item (by describing what I can see in the photos because the wishes when manually written in don’t even provide that information anymore), but at that point why am I even going through this app? My advice: If you plan on adding wishes from anything other than the “shop” they have, which they make commission off of so I can start to imagine why the other features have been removed or glitchy, then quite frankly don’t even waste your time.

reviews.title: Making Wishes Just Got Harder
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app for over 10 years with both sides of my family and everything has been ok until now (they are always tweaking something with it, but, other than being a nuisance to figure out the change, it was usable)
I am a mobile user and used to be able to add wishes to my wishlist using any websites share button and selecting the Elfster app… that no longer works! You have to manually link, describe and add a photo of your wishes unless it’s a wish available directly within the app.  It worked about a month ago for adding wishes for my daughter’s birthday, but now, nothing. I have older family members that will not be able to walk through the current wish process.
